title: Quality & Evaluation
ownership_note: 系统级表（规则、数据集、评估、指标、告警、发布）不带 owner_id；教师级表（检查、问题、数学验证、反馈、处置）带 owner_id 并受 RLS 约束。

tables.name: quality_rules
tables.purpose: 质量规则身份；版本在 quality_rule_versions

tables.name: quality_rule_versions
tables.purpose: 规则版本；不可变

fields.name: definition_hash
fields.desc: 定义 Hash，供 Snapshot 绑定

tables.name: quality_check_runs
tables.purpose: 对固定内容快照执行质量规则

fields.name: process_status
fields.desc: queued / running / succeeded / failed / cancelled / outcome_unknown

fields.name: issue_counts
fields.desc: 按严重度统计的问题数

tables.name: quality_check_rule_snapshots
tables.purpose: 本次 Run 固化的规则快照；保证事后可复现

tables.name: quality_check_results
tables.purpose: 单条规则的检查结果

fields.name: node_id
fields.desc: 命中的 AST 节点；整篇级结果为空

tables.name: quality_issues
tables.purpose: 需要教师处理的问题；由检查结果聚合而来

tables.name: quality_evidence
tables.purpose: 问题或结果的可追溯证据；必须是真实执行产物

fields.name: issue_id
fields.desc: 关联问题；可为空（结果级证据）

tables.name: math_validation_runs
tables.purpose: 对固定内容快照执行数学验证

fields.name: process_status
fields.desc: queued / running / succeeded / failed / cancelled / outcome_unknown

fields.name: coverage
fields.desc: 可判定节点数与覆盖情况

tables.name: math_validation_evidence
tables.purpose: 按层记录数学验证证据

tables.name: quality_issue_feedback
tables.purpose: 教师对问题的反馈；用于规则改进

tables.name: quality_issue_resolutions
tables.purpose: 问题处置记录；waive 必须留理由

constraints.name: ck_quality_issue_resolutions_reason
constraints.expr: resolution <> 'waived' OR (reason IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(reason)) > 0)

tables.name: quality_datasets
tables.purpose: 评估数据集身份

tables.name: quality_dataset_versions
tables.purpose: 数据集版本；不可变

tables.name: quality_dataset_items
tables.purpose: 数据集样本；冻结后不可修改

tables.name: quality_evaluations
tables.purpose: 评估定义；绑定数据集与目的

tables.name: quality_evaluation_runs
tables.purpose: 一次评估运行；固定数据集版本与全部影响结果的版本

tables.name: quality_evaluation_results
tables.purpose: 单样本评估结果

tables.name: quality_metrics
tables.purpose: 指标定义；含阻断标记

tables.name: quality_metric_observations
tables.purpose: 指标观测值

fields.name: sample_size
fields.desc: 样本量；不足时结果判 inconclusive

tables.name: quality_alerts
tables.purpose: 告警规则

tables.name: quality_alert_events
tables.purpose: 告警事件流

tables.name: quality_releases
tables.purpose: 发布批次；固定模型、Prompt、Harness、插件、工具与 Validator 版本

tables.name: quality_release_approvals
tables.purpose: 发布审批

tables.name: quality_release_events
tables.purpose: 发布过程事件；回滚不得删除教师已批准版本
